overview: The Commission approved several handicap parking signs and authorized traffic pattern changes for Osborne Road and Pearl Street. Members also held preliminary discussions on updating commercial vehicle parking regulations and the city's 48-hour parking limit.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the June meeting.

items.title: Handicap Parking Applications
items.summary: Approved handicap parking sign applications for 12 Hale Avenue, 29 Hamilton Street, and 118 Willis Avenue.

items.title: Osborne Road and Woburn Street Safety Improvements
items.summary: Approved a one-year pilot program for safety improvements at the intersection of Osborne Road, Woburn Street, and Playstead Road, including moving a stop sign and installing temporary physical barriers to tighten the intersection and reduce speeds.

items.title: Pearl Street Parking Plan
items.summary: Approved a staggered chicane parking plan for Pearl Street to address emergency vehicle access and illegal sidewalk parking by formalizing legal spots and slowing traffic.

items.title: Commercial Vehicle Rules and Regulations
items.summary: Discussed a proposal to allow residential permits for certain commercial vehicles meeting specific size criteria, with the matter referred for public outreach before a potential vote in September.

items.title: Parking Time Limits
items.summary: Discussed extending the city’s 48-hour parking violation window to 72 hours and referred the matter to the September agenda.
